---
title: "Publication-Ready Report"
author: "Health Data Science Team"
output:
  pdf_document: default
  html_document: default
params:
  data: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
if (!is.null(params$data)) {
  df <- params$data
}
```

## Overview

This report summarizes statistical analyses performed on the provided dataset with publication-quality formatting.

## Descriptive Statistics

```{r}
if (exists("df")) {
  summary(df)
} else {
  "No data supplied"
}
```

## Key Plot

```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
if (exists("df")) {
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(x = df[[1]], y = df[[2]])) +
    ggplot2::geom_point() +
    theme_publication()
  print(p)
} else {
  "No plot available"
}
```
